definitions.explanation: Involving or exposing to risk or harm.
The possibility of suffering harm or injury.

notes:
{危険|きけん} works both as a na-adjective and as a noun.

AS A NA-ADJECTIVE:
- {危険|きけん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: a dangerous place (before a noun)
- {危険|きけん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: it is dangerous (predicate)
- {危険|きけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become dangerous

AS A NOUN:
- {危険|きけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a danger
- {危険|きけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense danger
- {危険|きけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid danger

REGISTER: More formal and written than ⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧. Signs, warnings, and official notices use {危険|きけん}；everyday spoken warnings use ⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧. The bare sign {危険|きけん}！means 'Danger!'

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧: dangerous (plain, spoken; also 'Look out!')
- ⟦{危険性|きけんせい}→危険性：17827_kikensei⟧: riskiness, the degree of danger (abstract noun)
- ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧: risk (loanword; business and statistical contexts)
- ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧: crisis (a critical situation, not a hazard)
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧: safe, safety
